limitations: All issues, actions, authority records and retest observations are fictional.
The miniature retest windows do not support a future or institution-wide effectiveness claim.
I02 has one unresolved retest artifact; I04 has a provisional causal explanation.
I03 is ready for review, not closed; the assistant cannot supply independent approval.
Dates are evaluated at the saved Oct 09, 2026 snapshot, not renderer execution time.
conclusion: Three of six actions are evidenced complete, but no issue is currently closed. I03 is technically ready for independent closure review; I01 failed retest, I02 has an unresolved retest record, and I04’s acceptance expired without evidenced replacement. Three of four active issues are overdue at Oct 09, 2026.
report_narrative: Three of six existing actions meet their own acceptance criteria, while all four issues remain active. I03 is ready for independent closure review. I01, I02 and I04 have distinct effectiveness, evidence and acceptance blockers.

The complete fictional snapshot contains four issues and six existing actions at end-of-day Oct 09, 2026 ET. Calendar-day differences use approved current deadlines; proposed extensions do not reset the clock. Fourteen retest opportunities are fully listed.

I01’s R06 retest fails despite roster implementation. I02’s R10 is unresolved. I03 lacks final approval despite technical readiness. I04’s Sep 30 acceptance expired, and its proposed Oct 31 extension has no authorization.

IssueRegister shows overdue days of 7, 0, 2 and 9 for I01–I04. I01 remains Reopened after its Aug 31 closure and Sep 12 recurrence; I03 remains Closure review pending. Three active issues are overdue, or 75.0%.

ActionEvidence contains three Verified actions, one Failed, one Unresolved and one Not evidenced. Current overdue days are 0, 7, 0, 0, 0 and 9. A01’s three historical late days remain separate. A02 retest has 5 PASS and 1 FAIL; A04 has 3 PASS and 1 unresolved; A05 has 4 PASS.

SYN-001 preserves the causal facts, decision history and every retest ID. The backup roster did not establish effective coverage on Oct 06; the mechanism needs further assessment. R10 retrieval failure does not prove nonexistence. I04’s dependency explanation remains provisional. Public guidance supplies method context only.

Proposed follow-ups address failed coverage, recover R10, submit I03 for an actual independent decision, and resolve I04’s expired disposition and replacement plan. A02’s Oct 02 deadline preceded the end of its Oct 01–06 observation window and requires a feasible revised plan without erasing the breach.

QA reconciles 6 actions, 4 active issues and 14 retest units, preserving all missing outcomes. Negative controls reject proposed-date substitution, implementation-as-effectiveness and readiness-as-closure. No current final human closure decisions are supplied.
